findings.title: The quoted adversarial bound "EN >= 1.1173 V for trains under 7.62 ms per window" is not a bound: an admissible train gives 1.1162 V
findings.contradicts: r10_sch_check.py line 295 (generated into r10_binding_note.json line 589): "an adversarial search over 4000 trains under 7.62 ms per window kept EN at or above 1.1173 V against 1.116 V, Calculation"; the same figure in REQUIREMENTS F6 (line 60), M3_R10 line 270, ORDERING 8.3 line 617, R10_VALIDATION row 21 (line 2188) and D-R25-01 (R10_DECISIONS line 4251). Brief kind 4: a wrong calculation result in the records.
findings.evidence: Worst-corner EN model (R80 / R165 +1 %, R81 -1 %, C87 0.72 x 220 nF, 0.1 uA EN sink, D402 50 nA at J400.2 closed and through R165 open, VUVLO(F) 1.116 V, TI SLVSFC9C section 6.5 p9), which reproduces every D-R25-01 figure (window limits 7.629 / 5.871 / 9.594 ms, trip fractions 19.90 ... 5.82 % / 24.31 ... 8.32 %). Train: one open block of 7.6199 ms at the end of every 100 ms, from closed steady state at 5.73 V. Every sliding 100 ms window holds exactly 7.6199 ms open (< 7.62 ms). EN at the end of blocks 1 / 2 / 3 / 12: 1.13050 / 1.11716 / 1.11629 / 1.11623 V (probe r26_power/periodic_exact.py), i.e. below the 1.1173 V the record says no train reached. The same train at 7.6 ms (76 samples, exactly the budget of the triage search, which used X = int(0.999 x 7.6287 ms / 0.1 ms) = 76 samples) gives 1.11677 V, so the 4000-train search missed an admissible train inside its own grid. Why the periodic train is the extremum: with O(v) = vo + (v - vo)a and C(v) = vc + (v - vc)b the affine open / closed maps, C(O(v)) - O(C(v)) = (1 - a)(1 - b)(vc - vo) > 0, so moving open time later always lowers EN, and under a sliding-window budget the latest packing is one block per 100 ms. A random search of 3000 further admissible trains at 7.6 ms (r26_power/adversary.py, 0.05 ms grid) found nothing below the periodic train (best 1.11973 V vs 1.11677 V).
findings.impact: The record overstates the margin of the 7.63 ms worst-corner window limit (1.3 mV claimed, 0.23 mV real at 7.62 ms). The 7.63 ms limit itself and the 7 ms pass line are correct: at 7 ms the worst train gives EN 1.1330 V (17 mV margin).
findings.concrete_fix: Replace the search sentence with the analytic worst case: "the worst train under the window rule is one block per 100 ms (open-late swap argument); at 7.62 ms it reaches EN 1.1162 V, and at the 7 ms pass line 1.1330 V, against 1.116 V (Calculation)". Edit r10_sch_check.py line 295 and regenerate the binding note; update REQUIREMENTS F6, M3_R10 line 270, ORDERING line 617, R10_VALIDATION row 21; record a D-R26 decision annotating D-R25-01.

findings.title: "The fire budget four-stall BAT_IN of 5.73 V" is stale: the current fire budget gives 5.713 V, so the chatter figures and the bench voltage built on it are high
findings.contradicts: parts_budget.json (bound to board 92c3ad59..., generated by r10_parts.py fire_case) fire_current_GAP1 / primary_40mohm_FETs / pack_7V4_by_stall_count / 4 / loaded_pack_V = 5.713190 V (secondary_typical_hot_curve_FETs: 5.711161 V). The records state "the fire budget four-stall BAT_IN of 5.73 V" as the basis of the 8.2 ms single-drop-out figure, the 7.63 ms window limit and the bench rule "U9 stays on for the whole run at 5.73 V": r10_sch_check.py line 295 / binding note line 589 and tools/test_r10_check.py lines 399-402; REQUIREMENTS F4 (line 58), F6 (line 60) and line 106; AGENTS.md section 1 power row; STATUS lines 11 and 16; M3_R10 lines 270, 590-591; ORDERING 617; R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF 68-69; R10_VALIDATION rows 21 / R23-POWER-02 / R23-REQUIREMENTS-05; D-R24-19 / D-R25-01. Brief kind 4 (wrong input) and kind 3 (statement contradicts the generated budget).
findings.evidence: 5.73 V is the round 18 value: git show 6628488^ parts_budget.json gives loaded_pack_V 5.731822 V with other_converter_load_W 12.371 W. D-R19-14 (spare AUX port, 0.1 A at 4.8 V) raised other_converter_load_W to 13.064 W (current budget), and the same function now gives 5.713190 V (r10_parts.py lines 441-449: rest = R134 hot + 2 + 0.3 + copper + allowances + 2 x 40 mOhm + Q124, 0.15 Ohm pack incl. leads, 4 x 1.92 A). Re-run of the worst-corner EN model at the current point (r26_power, en_model.py / frac.py): single drop-out 8.067 ms at 5.713 V and 8.051 ms at 5.711 V (records: 8.2 ms); one-block-per-100 ms window limit 7.503 / 7.488 ms (records: 7.63 ms at 5.73 V); EN at the 7 ms pass line 1.1295 / 1.1291 V. At 5.7318 V the same model gives 8.219 ms / 7.642 ms, confirming the 5.73 V figures are the pre-AUX point.
findings.impact: The bench rule runs the functional "U9 stays on" check 17-19 mV above the current four-stall-plus-fire BAT_IN, and the quoted immunity (8.2 ms) and window limit (7.63 ms) are about 0.13-0.15 ms high. The 7 ms pass line still holds at 5.711 V (limit 7.49 ms, margin 0.49 ms instead of the stated 0.63 ms). The 5.37 V four-stall-plus-fire corner of rule 8 was also derived from the 5.73 V point (round23_power.json) and shifts by about the same 0.02 V.
findings.concrete_fix: Quote the current fire-budget point, 5.71 V (5.713 / 5.711 V), wherever "four-stall BAT_IN of 5.73 V" appears; recompute the figures there (single drop-out 8.05 ms, window limit 7.49 ms, margin 0.49 ms) and set the bench run "U9 stays on for the whole run at <= 5.71 V". Edit r10_sch_check.py line 295 and the pins in tools/test_r10_check.py lines 399-402, regenerate the binding note, update the docs listed, and record a D-R26 decision. Better: have r10_parts.py export the four-stall BAT_IN and the window limit so the text cannot drift from the budget again.

observations: D-R25-01 window limits reproduced exactly: 7.629 / 5.871 / 9.594 ms at 5.73 / 5.5 / 6.0 V (also 18.40 / 23.59 ms at 7.4 / 8.4 V); a +/- corner search over all 128 corners confirms R80 / R165 +1 %, R81 -1 %, C87 0.72x, +0.1 uA, D402 50 nA is the worst.

Periodic trip-fraction table reproduced exactly (exact periodic steady state): 5.73 V 20.01 / 19.90 / 18.91 / 17.74 / 15.11 / 11.80 / 5.82 %, single-trip at 9.9 ms; 6.0 V 24.41 / 24.31 / 23.39 / 22.32 / 19.96 / 17.21 / 13.74 / 8.32 %.
F6 counter-examples reproduced: 8 ms every 50 ms at 6.0 V gives EN 1.0953 V; 3 x 4 ms with 0.2 ms closures at 5.73 V gives 1.0277 V.

D-R24-19 EN figures reproduced: single drop-out 10.345 / 20.111 / 26.023 ms at 6.0 / 7.4 / 8.4 V, 8.204 ms at 5.73 V, 6.300 ms at 5.5 V; nominal 18.9 / 32.8 / 41.1 ms; pack floor for a single 10 ms drop-out 5.956 V; turn-on 30.31-130.27 ms (nominal 87.7 / 55.5 / 44.7 ms); pack window on 4.723-5.251 V, off 4.288-4.802 V (nominal 4.960 / 4.505 V).
The 7 ms rule fails at 5.5 V (window limit 5.87 ms, EN 1.086 V at 7 ms); 5.5 V is quoted only as a sensitivity point, below the stated four-stall operating floor, so this is not a finding.

PA6 lower trip edge with the fitted 1 % R60 / R61 (0402WGF) is 0.44 x 10.80 = 4.753 V VLOGIC (upper 5.265 V); the records give only the upper 1 % edge and leave the window "to be qualified with the divider and ADC tolerances" (disclosed). From 4.753 V the all-ports hold-up would be 0.094 ms.

Hold-up from the trip reproduced: C (V1^2 - 3.8^2) / 2P at 300.8 uF with battery_break_load_W gives 0.1034-0.1643 ms (11.249-13.064 W) and 0.2906-0.4303 ms (4.295-4.650 W) over VLOGIC 4.84-5.17 V; fractions of the break-to-3.8 V hold-up 0.223-0.305.
OVLO corner reproduced: (1.223 V + 0.1 uA x 2.002 M || 279.72 k) x 2.28172 / 0.27972 = 10.1765 V (TI SLVSFC9C 6.5: VOV(R) 1.183-1.223 V, IOVLKG +/-0.1 uA for 0.5-1.5 V on the pin).

Buck prospective peak reproduced: all_shorts 3.16050 A (TPS2553 IOS max 1.2495 A at 22.6 k x 0.98, LDO 1.9 A, 11 mA) plus half-ripple at Vo 5.3667 V, 10.1765 V, 5.44 uH: 3.6565 A at 470 kHz, 3.6268 A at 500 kHz. U9 bound 3.1 + 2.225 / 3.5 + 10.1765 / 3234 + 0.005 = 3.743861 A < 3.94619 A; R92 bleed 3.147 mA.

K-power run read-only on the board (check_r10.power_paths): 0 issues; every floor is at least its IPC-2152 width at a 30 C rise (2.9 A 0.68 mm vs 1.0 / 0.7 mm; 1.9 A 0.326 mm, 1.81 A 0.299 mm, 2.0 A 0.356 mm, 1.294 A 0.167 mm, 1.249 A 0.157 mm vs 0.4 mm); the six POWER_NARROW entries are pad-pitch or pad-width limited (U9.5 / U9.6 pads are 0.3 x 2.4 mm).

Hot-plug binding consistent: hotplug_inputs.json board_sha256 = 92c3ad59...; r10_hotplug.digest(inputs) and model_sha() equal hotplug_results.json inputs_sha256 / model_sha256; limits -15 V / 10 V/us / 100 V/us match TPS25947 SLVSFC9C 6.1; minimum -14.807 V with the retained-OUT bound 5.914 V keeping max(-15, VOUT - 21) at -15 V.

Regulator taps on the board match the budget inputs: R400 56.2 k / R404 2 k / R401 10 k (0.1 % / 1 % / 0.1 %), R402 49.9 k / R403 10 k (0.1 %), R430 22.6 k, R84 750 R 0.1 %, R82 2 M / R83 280 k 0.1 %, R85 66.5 k, R86 80.6 k 0.1 %; AP63201 VFB 792-808 mV and TPS7A91 IFB +/-100 nA as coded (DS41326 p5, SBVS282A p5).

U11 (TPS2121, R86 80.6 k) has a 1-2 A limit (SLVSEA3F 7.5 at 80 k) below the 1.294 A VLOGIC copper design current; that current is U2's rated-output copper basis, not a stated load (logic allocation about 0.4 A), so not a finding.
